semanticDecisions: M3LongLfuCache: capacity fixed at construction (1..2^29); table sized once to >= 1.5 x capacity, never grows; tombstone sweep rebuilds same-size lanes keeping bucket ids and order
M3LongLfuCache: get counts a use and is a structural modification for the fail-fast iterator (LinkedHashMap access-order precedent); peekOrDefault/containsKey/frequencyOf do not count
M3LongLfuCache: eviction = head (least recently used) of the minimum-frequency bucket, LeetCode 460 tie rule; lastEvictedKey/Value + evictionCount expose it without allocation

M3LongPatriciaTrie: keys ordered by bit string = Long.compareUnsigned; prefixKeys/prefixCount(prefix, bits 0..64) = Commons prefixMap over the top bits; ceiling/floor/higher/lower OrDefault navigation; removal swap-moves the last leaf and last internal node so both arenas stay dense; lanes grow by doubling and never shrink
M3LaneAlgorithms: Collections.rotate distance semantics for any int distance; partition3 returns packed (low, high) bounds; compact is stable and realigns the mask; firstAbsent permutes the lane
per-element allocation: 0 for all three owners; only transient facades (M3LongIterator) and result arrays (keysByEviction) allocate
not java.util: primitive proving-ground surfaces only
